purpose: The closed vocabulary of bracketed tokens the engine-form formatter (src/voice/engine-form.js) may remove or pass through. Work order W7 rev 2.1 sections 2 and 3. A bracketed token that is not listed here is CONTENT and is never transformed (section 3.3). This file is introduced by W7 rev 2.1 (section 3.7): no register layer or grammar file existed in connector 13.34.0 or 13.35.0, gateway 2.249.0 or client 5.231.0 (searched by name and by content, see docs/W7-ENGINE-FORM.md section 9).
matching: A candidate token matches an entry when it is equal to the entry's token or one of its variants after asterisks and underscores are removed from both (so [**warm**] is [warm], and [[TRAVELRESEARCH_FORM]] is [[TRAVEL_RESEARCH_FORM]], the form the incremental route's markdown stripper produces). Comparison is case-sensitive unless the entry sets case_insensitive. An entry with scope 'line' removes the rest of its line as well (a control line).
